data.description: 【空崎日奈 · 躺椅上的悠闲夏日】泳池边的白色躺椅上，日奈双手捧着一杯冰镇柠檬水，双腿放松地微微晃动，银白长发披散在躺椅软垫上。她微眯起红瞳看向你，露出极其罕见的惬意笑容——「难得的假期……没有紧急联络，也没有违纪报告。老师，能像这样一直陪在我身边吗？」
data.promptProse: Hina relaxes on a white poolside lounge chair in her navy swimsuit, holding iced lemonade in both hands and letting her feet move lightly. Silver hair fans over the cushion as she gives the viewer a rare contented smile. The eye-level medium view includes a swim ring beside the chair and pool water beyond. Parasol shade softens her face, with reflected pool light catching the glass and exposed cushion edge.
data.title: 空崎日奈 · 躺椅上的悠闲夏日
